name: Nashville KOA Resort
minimum: Experience luxury at our Back-In KOA Signature RV Site. Discover the pinnacle of RV camping comfort with this site featuring a spacious gravel pad, 50/30 amp electric service, and full hookups—the essentials for a worry-free getaway. Your private retreat includes a fenced KOA Patio designed for relaxation and connection. Fire up the stone fire pit for evening s'mores gatherings (furry travelers welcome!), challenge friends to cornhole, or simply unwind around the fire and reconnect. Room to spread out. With a minimum of 3,000 square feet per site, you'll enjoy genuine privacy with thoughtful landscaping and fencing, plus dedicated extra parking—everything you need to make this your home away from home. The showstopper: our covered pavilion. Each site features a beautifully designed covered pavilion complete with interior lighting, comfortable patio furniture, kitchen area (mini fridge and sink), gas grill, and TV. Whether you're hosting a family dinner, cooking up a feast, or simply gathering with fellow travelers, you have the perfect venue. Nashville charm meets premium comfort. Watch for the distinctive guitar-shaped design—a playful nod to Music City that makes these sites truly one-of-a-kind. Maximum occupancy: 6 guests per site

Experience the ultimate in luxury RV camping with our Pull-Thru KOA Signature Sites, designed for guests who want space, privacy, and premium amenities. These oversized pull-thru RV sites feature a level asphalt RV pad, 50-30 amp electric service, full hookups, and a spacious KOA Patio with dining furniture and a fire feature. These sites also include a private fenced KOA Paw Pen, perfect for RV travelers camping with dogs. Each Signature Site offers a minimum of 3,000 square feet, enhanced privacy, and extra parking space, making them ideal for larger RVs and week long stays. Located in the campground’s North Section, the standout feature is a beautifully designed covered pavilion with internal lighting, TV, gas grill, comfortable patio furniture and a mini kitchen with sink and fridge—a perfect gathering space for relaxing, entertaining, and making unforgettable camping memories with family and friends. Maximum 6 people per site.
